catalog.name: Retyping data between systems
catalog.shape: The same records are read in one system and typed by hand into another, on a regular cycle.
catalog.firstStep: List the fields you retype and where each one comes from, then connect the two systems on one record type.
catalog.failureMode: Field formats differ between systems, so the first runs need a person checking every record.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Assembling a recurring report
catalog.shape: A report is rebuilt on a schedule by pulling the same exports or tables and reshaping them by hand.

tools.name: Google Sheets connected sheets and macros

catalog.firstStep: Save the steps you repeat each cycle as a query, so next time the report refreshes from the new export.
catalog.failureMode: A change in the source export's columns silently breaks the refresh.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work and teams the author led. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Inbox triage and routine replies
catalog.shape: A high volume of email arrives, much of it sorted, summarized into to-dos, or answered with similar replies.
catalog.firstStep: Turn on the inbox summary each morning and copy its action items into your to-do list for a week.
catalog.failureMode: Summaries miss the one message that mattered, so important senders still need a rule that flags them.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Meeting notes to action items
catalog.shape: Notes are taken during or after recurring meetings and turned by hand into action items and follow-ups.

tools.name: Take notes for me in Google Meet

catalog.firstStep: Turn on the meeting recap for one recurring meeting and compare its action list with your own for two weeks.
catalog.failureMode: Recaps assign actions to the wrong person when names are not said aloud.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led, 15 Creative client work and AmpStack.ai. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Drafting documents from a template
catalog.shape: Similar documents (proposals, briefs, letters, listings) are written repeatedly from the same structure.
catalog.firstStep: Save your best past document as the template and write down the three inputs that change each time.
catalog.failureMode: Drafts read as generic when the inputs are thin, so the time moves from writing to editing.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Answering repeat questions
catalog.shape: The same questions arrive from colleagues or customers and are answered from the same sources each time.
catalog.firstStep: Collect the ten questions you answered most last month and put the answers on one shared page.
catalog.failureMode: Answers go stale when the source page is not owned by anyone.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work and teams the author led. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Reconciling two lists or records
catalog.shape: Two lists or record sets are compared line by line to find mismatches, missing items or duplicates.

tools.name: XLOOKUP and Power Query merge in Microsoft Excel

catalog.firstStep: Put both lists in one workbook and add a lookup column that marks every row with no match.
catalog.failureMode: Keys differ slightly between the lists (spacing, codes), so matches are missed until the keys are cleaned.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Chasing status updates and approvals
catalog.shape: Time goes to asking people for updates or sign-offs and tracking who has replied.
catalog.firstStep: Move one recurring request into a form or workflow that sends reminders by itself.
catalog.failureMode: People ignore automated reminders that arrive too often.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Finding files and information
catalog.shape: Time is spent searching folders, chats and email for documents or facts that already exist.
catalog.firstStep: Write down the next five things you search for and note where each one was found.
catalog.failureMode: Search cannot find what was never saved to a shared place.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Scheduling and coordination
catalog.shape: Back-and-forth messages are used to find meeting times or coordinate people's calendars.
catalog.firstStep: Publish a booking page with your open hours and send it instead of proposing times.
catalog.failureMode: Booking pages fill focus time unless protected blocks are set first.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Monitoring news and sources as a daily briefing
catalog.shape: Several news sites, feeds or competitor pages are checked by hand to stay current.
catalog.firstStep: List the sources you check and set alerts for the topics, then read one digest a day.
catalog.failureMode: Too many alerts and the digest becomes another inbox.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Gaps after back-to-back meetings
catalog.shape: Several meetings run back to back with no time to act on them.
catalog.firstStep: Set meetings you own to end five minutes early by default.
catalog.failureMode: Other people's meetings still run to the hour.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Checking email in batches
catalog.shape: Email takes a large share of the week and is checked continuously.
catalog.firstStep: Pick set times to check email and turn off notifications in between for one week.
catalog.failureMode: Urgent requests come by phone or chat instead, so tell people how to reach you.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Grouping similar tasks
catalog.shape: Several tasks use the same tool but are spread across the day or week.
catalog.firstStep: Put the tasks that use the same tool into one block on your calendar.
catalog.failureMode: Blocks get booked over unless they are marked busy.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.

catalog.name: Replacing a status meeting with a written update
catalog.shape: Meetings take a large share of the week, some of them for status only.
catalog.firstStep: Propose a written update for one status meeting and keep the meeting slot for questions only.
catalog.failureMode: Written updates get skimmed; keep a short live slot for decisions.
catalog.sourceNote: Seen working in the author's own work, teams the author led and 15 Creative client work. Confirmed by the author, Oct 14, 2026.
